digest.component_or_area: Reconciler field-contract registry and property tests
propositions: Reconciler parity bugs escape because per-field asymmetry policy lives scattered across four separate call sites with no single declarative source of truth.
A declarative field-contract registry must enumerate each reconciled field with its symmetry class (bidirectional-roundtrip, add-wins, or one-way-with-propagation-gate) plus codec/gate references.
Property tests parameterized off the registry must enforce coverage via import-time guard that fails collection if any handled field lacks a registry entry.
Roundtrip identity, add-wins idempotence, and gate-consulted behavior must be asserted through real call paths for their respective symmetry classes.
Registration-contract convention must be documented in architecture.md to durably establish that new reconciled fields require registry declaration.
